title: Axiomatic projective geometry (Faure–Frölicher)
abstract: Develops, following Faure and Frölicher's Modern Projective Geometry, the axiomatic theory of projective geometries given by a ternary collinearity relation, with subspaces and subgeometries, proves that the central projection between two lines is a bijection, and exhibits every Mathlib projectivization as a projective geometry. Groundwork from the upstream desargues repository — Desargues' theorem itself is not formalized.

informal.Basic.ProjectiveGeometry: Axiomatizes a projective geometry as a typeclass (axioms L₁–L₃, Faure–Frölicher p. 26) on a ternary collinearity relation.
informal.Basic.centralProjection: Defines the central projection of a line onto another from a center point.
informal.Basic.cen_proj_bij: The headline theorem — the central projection between two lines is a bijection.
